{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "A tailored linen-blend blazer, structured shoulder cut with a slightly cropped length, sand color (#e0d5c2), lightweight woven fabric.
High-waisted wide-leg trousers, tapered ankle length, soft khaki hue (#b8b09e), breathable tropical wool blend.
Silk blouse, relaxed collarless fit with slight drape at the hem, pale ivory shade (#f5f0e6), fluid chiffon material.
Strappy block-heel sandals, open toe design with ankle strap, taupe tone (#a89f91), leather construction.
Small metallic clutch bag, rectangular shape with chain handle, brushed gold finish (#d4af37), glossy patent leather.
This ensemble balances the semi-formal requirements of a wedding guest role while adapting seamlessly from an outdoor garden setting to an indoor restaurant venue. The breathable fabrics like linen and tropical wool ensure comfort during the late August heat, preventing overheating when transitioning between shade and artificial light. Neutral earth tones in the palette harmonize with warm skin undertones and create a versatile look that remains elegant without overpowering the celebratory atmosphere."}
